================================================================================
Case statement with a separate in keyword
================================================================================
case x in foo) ;; esac
---
(program (word) (word))

================================================================================
For loop with a separate in keyword
================================================================================
for x in foo a; do p; done
---
(program (variable_name) (word) (word) (cmd (word)))

================================================================================
Whole word after in stays one word
================================================================================
select x in infoo; do p; done
---
(program (variable_name) (word) (cmd (word)))

================================================================================
Dollar expansion keeps the raw dash literal
================================================================================
$-
---
(program)

================================================================================
Dollar expansion keeps the raw in literal
================================================================================
$in
---
(program)

================================================================================
Glued in is not a keyword:error
================================================================================
case x in-foo) ;; esac
---
(ERROR (word) (word))

================================================================================
Glued in prefix is not a keyword:error
================================================================================
case x inout) ;; esac
---
(ERROR (word) (word))

================================================================================
Glued in in a for header is rejected:error
================================================================================
for x infoo a; do p; done
---
(ERROR (variable_name) (word) (word) (word))

================================================================================
Glued in in a select header is rejected:error
================================================================================
select x infoo; do p; done
---
(ERROR (variable_name) (word) (word))
